notes: New Apple Devices tab (iOS/iPadOS): plug in an iPhone or iPad to read full identity (model, serial, IMEI, UDID), battery health with cycle count and a Good/Replace verdict, storage, software version, and Find My / Activation Lock status — with a plain-English findings list and health score, like the PC issue scanner. Read-only; nothing is changed on the device. This release adds the full interface and diagnostics engine; the device-reading tools themselves arrive in the next full portable build (the tab shows setup guidance until then). Syncro asset registration is the next phase.
